metadata.description: Name of the Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace.
Unique identifier for the analytics rule.

properties.displayName: SQL-DB-usecase4 - Multiple Failed SQL Database Logins from Same Source IP - SecurityEvent
properties.description: Detects more than five failed SQL Server database login attempts within any sliding 300-second window from the same source IP. The rule uses MSSQLSERVER SecurityEvent 18456 records and a ten-minute lookback so attempts spanning scheduled-query boundaries are detected. Validate EventData parsing against the workspace before enabling.
properties.query:
let FailedLoginThreshold = 5;
let DetectionWindow = 5m;
let FailedEvents = materialize(
    SecurityEvent
    | where EventSourceName =~ "MSSQLSERVER" and EventID == 18456
    | extend RawEventData = tostring(EventData)
    | extend ParsedEventData = trim(" ", replace_regex(replace_regex(RawEventData, @"<[^>]+>", " "), @"\s+", " "))
    | extend DatabaseUser = coalesce(
        extract(@"(?is)<LoginName>(.*?)</LoginName>", 1, RawEventData),
        extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)(?:LoginName|login_name|server_principal_name|param1)(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
        extract(@"(?i)Login failed for user\s+(?:\x27|\x22)(.*?)(?:\x27|\x22)", 1, ParsedEventData),
        extract(@"^([^ ]+)", 1, ParsedEventData))
    | extend FailureReason = coalesce(
        extract(@"(?is)<Reason>(.*?)</Reason>", 1, RawEventData),
        extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)(?:Reason|reason|param2)(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
        extract(@"(?i)Reason:\s*(.*?)(?:\s+\[CLIENT:|$)", 1, ParsedEventData))
    | extend SourceClient = coalesce(
        extract(@"(?i)\[CLIENT:\s*([^\]]+)\]", 1, ParsedEventData),
        extract(@"(?is)<ClientIp>(.*?)</ClientIp>", 1, RawEventData),
        extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)(?:client_ip|param3)(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData))
    | extend SourceClient = replace_string(SourceClient, "<local machine>", "local machine")
    | extend SourceIpAddress = extract(@"((?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}|[0-9A-Fa-f:]{2,})", 1, SourceClient)
    | where isnotempty(SourceIpAddress)
    | extend DatabaseHost = Computer
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceIpAddress, SourceClient, DatabaseUser, FailureReason, DatabaseHost
);
FailedEvents
| project SourceIpAddress, WindowStart = TimeGenerated
| join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (
    FailedEvents
    | project SourceIpAddress, AttemptTime = TimeGenerated, DatabaseUser, FailureReason, DatabaseHost
) on SourceIpAddress
| where AttemptTime between (WindowStart .. (WindowStart + DetectionWindow))
| summarize
    FailedLoginCount = count(),
    FirstAttempt = min(AttemptTime),
    LastAttempt = max(AttemptTime),
    TargetedDatabaseUsers = make_set(DatabaseUser, 25),
    FailureReasons = make_set(FailureReason, 10),
    DatabaseHosts = make_set(DatabaseHost, 10)
    by SourceIpAddress, WindowStart
| where FailedLoginCount > FailedLoginThreshold
| where LastAttempt > ago(5m)
| summarize arg_max(FailedLoginCount, *) by SourceIpAddress
| extend TargetedDatabaseUsersText = strcat_array(TargetedDatabaseUsers, ", ")
| extend FailureReasonsText = strcat_array(FailureReasons, ", ")
| extend DatabaseHostsText = strcat_array(DatabaseHosts, ", ")
| project SourceIpAddress, FailedLoginCount, FirstAttempt, LastAttempt, TargetedDatabaseUsersText, FailureReasonsText, DatabaseHostsText

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{FailedLoginCount}} failed SQL database logins from {{SourceIpAddress}} targeted {{TargetedDatabaseUsersText}} within 300 seconds.
